title: Lot Storage Tariff by Estimate Type (Repair Estimates & Appointments)
content:
A vehicle left at a center after a Repair Estimates & Appointments estimate can accrue storage only on the estimate types marked below. The free days, the daily rate and the lien referral point are:

| Estimate type | Storage can accrue | Free storage days | Daily storage rate | Lien referral after (calendar days of accrued storage) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Photo Estimate | No | 0 | 0.00 USD | 0 |
| Drive-In Estimate | No | 0 | 0.00 USD | 0 |
| Scheduled Estimate | No | 0 | 0.00 USD | 0 |
| Mobile Estimate | No | 0 | 0.00 USD | 0 |
| Blueprint Teardown Estimate | Yes | 3 | 55.00 USD | 30 |
| Structural Blueprint Estimate | Yes | 3 | 65.00 USD | 30 |

Tariff terms:

- **Storage can accrue** — whether the vehicle stays at the center after the estimate so that storage can accrue.
- **Free storage days** — the calendar days after the estimate written date during which a vehicle left at the center is stored free.
- **Daily storage rate** — the storage charge per calendar day beyond the free days.
- **Lien referral** — the calendar days of accrued storage after which the vehicle is referred to the abandoned-vehicle lien process; 0 means not applicable.

Only the two teardown types store vehicles: both give 3 free days and refer to the lien process after 30 days of accrued storage; the daily rate is 55.00 USD on the Blueprint Teardown Estimate and 65.00 USD on the Structural Blueprint Estimate.
